title: Starting a South Australian tenancy
description: The paperwork and steps before and when a South Australian tenant signs. Summarised from Consumer and Business Services and SA.GOV.AU guidance on applications, agreements, inspection sheets and bonds.

sources.title: Tenancy reforms for landlords and agents
Forms and fact sheets for private rental tenancies

items.title: Check the property meets the minimum housing standards before the tenant moves in
Advertise at one fixed rent and don't invite higher offers
Take applications only on the SA Form A1 tenancy application, one per applicant
items.detail: Don't ask for legal history, medical records, social media or vehicle registration.

items.title: Prepare the SA fixed term residential tenancy agreement or the SA periodic residential tenancy agreement
For a lease of 90 days or less, give the SA Form 1 short fixed term tenant information
Give the tenant the SA tenant information guide
Give your contact details on the SA information to be provided to tenant form
Complete the SA inspection sheet with the tenant, with dated photos
Test the smoke alarms and record them on the inspection sheet
Take no more than 4 weeks' rent as bond (6 weeks if rent is over $800 a week)
Lodge the bond through SA Residential Bonds Online
Check the pool barrier and gate work
Store tenant information securely and delete unsuccessful applicants' details on time
Give the tenant a copy of the signed agreement
